title: de Havilland Comet 增壓疲勞案例
titleEn: de Havilland Comet pressurization fatigue case
summary: 以Comet增壓疲勞案例學習為何靜態強度不足以解釋反覆載荷下的破壞；將殼體平均應力、開口局部應力、循環譜和檢測分開。十個單元依序進行機制、定量、量測與診斷，每單元可改一個變數比較結果。
summaryEn: Use the Comet pressurization-fatigue case to learn why static strength alone cannot explain repeated-load failure, separating shell mean stress, cut-out stress, cycle spectra and inspection. Ten units each progress through mechanism, calculation, measurement and diagnosis, with a one-variable comparison.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

steps.title: 反覆增壓的殼體平均應力：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Shell mean stress under repeated pressurization: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 反覆增壓的殼體平均應力 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Shell mean stress under repeated pressurization and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 薄壁筒殼的環向膜應力由壓差、半徑及壁厚決定；反覆增壓形成疲勞循環而非單次靜載問題。
steps.instructionEn: Hoop membrane stress in a thin shell depends on differential pressure, radius and thickness; repeated pressurization creates fatigue cycles rather than only one static load.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非de Havilland Comet 增壓疲勞案例實際性能或製程：壓差p=40000 Pa，r=1.5 m，t=0.002 m。式 σh=pr/t，基準結果 30 MPa。適用條件：薄壁圓筒膜模型，未含窗框、開口、複材鋪層或端部效應。 應力若以Pa算出，除10⁶轉MPa；N/mm²已等於MPa。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for de Havilland Comet pressurization fatigue case: Differential pressure p=40000 Pa, r=1.5 m and t=0.002 m. Formula σh=pr/t gives 30 MPa. Conditions: Thin circular-cylinder membrane model, excluding windows, cut-outs, composite layup and end effects. Divide pascals by 10^6 for MPa; N/mm² already equals MPa.
steps.failure: 把艙內絕對壓力當壓差會高估負載；忽略開口局部應力則會低估風險。
steps.failureEn: Cabin absolute pressure instead of differential pressure overstates load, while omitted cut-out stress understates local risk.
steps.check: 沿環向與軸向布置虛擬應變通道，把壓差與循環次數分開保存。
steps.checkEn: Place virtual hoop and axial strain channels and retain differential pressure separately from cycle count.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「de Havilland Comet 增壓疲勞案例」的「反覆增壓的殼體平均應力：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出機體、能源、感測、控制與地面驗證的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「機體試驗：載荷有跡可循」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與試件構型、質量或負載表、原始量測與需求版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Shell mean stress under repeated pressurization: Mechanism and observation” in “de Havilland Comet pressurization fatigue case”. Draw the airframe, energy, sensing, control and ground-verification interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Airframe Trials: Trace the Load” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for specimen configuration, mass/load manifest, raw measurements and requirement version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.
